name: campaign-ops-mcp
description: An MCP server that lets AI agents change Google Ads campaigns safely: propose, dry run, human approval, apply, verify, rollback, with Fair Housing guardrails, a tamper-evident audit log checked against Google's own change history, and Pulse alarms. Runs on your computer or on Cloudflare's free plan, where every approval is signed with a passkey.
author: Debashish Kumar Bora

scripts.cloud:setup: npm run build && node dist/scripts/cloud.js setup
scripts.cloud:deploy: npm run build && node dist/scripts/cloud.js deploy
scripts.cloud:code: npm run build && node dist/scripts/cloud.js code
scripts.cloud:unlink-desktop: npm run build && node dist/scripts/cloud.js unlink-desktop
